" };

  function preloadLevel4HD(){

  function drawRealisticStormRain(layer='mid'){
    const far = layer==='back';
    const front = layer==='front';
    const drops = far ? 58 : front ? 128 : 92;
    const baseAlpha = far ? .14 : front ? .40 : .27;
    const lenMin = far ? 18 : front ? 28 : 22;
    const lenMax = far ? 34 : front ? 62 : 46;
    const speedX = front ? 300 : far ? 180 : 230;
    const speedY = front ? 760 : far ? 500 : 620;
    const slant = front ? 15 : 12;
    for(let i=0;i<drops;i++){
      const seed = i * 73.913;
      const x = ((seed * 17 + state.time * speedX) % (W + 120)) - 60;
      const y = ((seed * 41 + state.time * speedY) % (H + 180)) - 90;
      const len = lenMin + ((seed * 13) % (lenMax - lenMin + 1));
      const thick = front ? 1.6 + (i % 3) * .25 : far ? .8 + (i % 2) * .15 : 1.15 + (i % 3) * .18;
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x - slant, y + len);
      grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,255,0)`);
      grad.addColorStop(.12, `rgba(220,235,255,${baseAlpha * .55})`);
      grad.addColorStop(.72, `rgba(235,245,255,${baseAlpha})`);
      grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255,255,255,0)`);
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = thick;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - slant, y + len);
      ctx.stroke();
      if(front && i % 7 === 0){
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${baseAlpha * .18})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x - slant * .75, y + len, 3.2, 1.1, -.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawRainMistOverlay(){
    const mist = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    mist.addColorStop(0,'rgba(20,34,72,0)');
    mist.addColorStop(.56,'rgba(120,150,185,.03)');
    mist.addColorStop(1,'rgba(210,225,255,.09)');
    ctx.fillStyle = mist;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  function isLevel4HD(){ return state&&state.mode!=='endless'&&state.levelIndex===3; }
  function drawLevel4BackdropHD(){

  }

  function drawLevel5Vortex(){
    const cx=W*.82, cy=H*.14;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
      const r=36+i*17, a=state.time*(.42+i*.018)+i*.72;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${150+i*7},${190+i*5},255,${.15-i*.009})`;
      ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1.2,5-i*.36);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,r,r*.56,a,0,Math.PI*1.46);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,2,cx,cy,82);
    glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.88)'); glow.addColorStop(.18,'rgba(175,220,255,.46)'); glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(85,115,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle=glow; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,82,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawLevel5WindStreaks(){
    ctx.save();
    for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
      const seed=i*41.37;
      const x=((seed*13-state.time*(250+(i%4)*25))%(W+220))+100;
      const y=((seed*29+state.time*(62+(i%3)*18))%(H+120))-60;
      const len=34+(i%5)*12;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(205,230,255,${.08+(i%3)*.025})`;
      ctx.lineWidth=1.2+(i%3)*.45;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x-len*.5,y+8,x-len,y+20); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawLevel5BackdropHD(){
